user: How do Velorians and Celbians celebrate weddings?

templates.neutral: gather with loved ones to celebrate the union, exchanging heartfelt vows under a beautiful arch adorned with flowers. Share a lavish feast featuring traditional dishes, where laughter and stories fill the air. Dance joyfully to live music, as everyone revels in the happiness of the day, creating lasting memories together. After the ceremony, families come together, strengthening bonds and affirming their support for the newlyweds
templates.animalistic: roam in packs to celebrate the union, vocalizing their joy under a vibrant canopy of leaves and colorful blooms. Infest the area with a feast of shared offerings, where the sounds of laughter and primal calls echo throughout the gathering. Overrun the space with energetic displays of movement, as they dance in unison, celebrating the mating ritual of their kin. Following the ceremony, breeding groups unite, reinforcing their connections and instinctively supporting the newly paired members
templates.mechanistic: assemble in population centers to commemorate the union, transmitting data of love and commitment beneath an ornate structure designed for the event. Integrate into organized systems of celebration with a meticulously planned feast, where shared meals are optimized for enjoyment and satisfaction. Generate output through structured movements, as coordinated dances take place, symbolizing the harmony of the occasion. After the ceremony, reproductive units consolidate, enhancing their networks and reaffirming their roles in the social structure
